SELECT VALUATION FROM FIN_PRODUCT_VALUATION
FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} and VAL_DATE = STR_TO_DATE(#{netDate},'%Y-%m-%d')

select tpd.TRADE_ID tradeId, tpda.ENTRUST_ID entrustId, IFNULL(pt.PORTFOLIO_ID, tpda.PORTFOLIO_ID) portfolioId, ee.ENTRUST_AMT - tpd.TRADE_AMT doEntrustMoney, tpd.TRADE_AMT tradeAmt, tpd.SHARE_AMT shareAmt from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL tpd left join TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD tpda on tpda.TRADE_ID = tpd.TRADE_ID left join ETR_ENTRUST ee on ee.ENTRUST_ID = tpda.ENTRUST_ID
left join ptl_trade pt on pt.BUSI_NO = tpd.TRADE_ID and pt.PORTFOLIO_ID != tpda.PORTFOLIO_ID
where tpd.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{totleTradeId} order by tpd.create_time
SELECT IFNULL(Entrust_Amt,0) entrustAmt, IFNULL(Entrust_Num,0) entrustNum FROM ETR_ENTRUST WHERE ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId}
